name: Warning text
summary: Use warning text to alert users to an important consequence of an action or inaction.
whenToUse: Use when users need to understand a serious consequence before deciding what to do.
Place it immediately before the related action or decision when timing matters.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for ordinary guidance, validation errors or successful outcomes.
Do not show several warning-text components on one page, which makes it difficult to identify the most important consequence.

anatomy.name: Warning container
anatomy.description: A govuk-warning-text groups the icon and message.

anatomy.name: Decorative icon
anatomy.description: The exclamation mark is hidden from assistive technology using aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: Warning message
anatomy.description: Strong text contains a visually hidden Warning label followed by the consequence.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A serious consequence on the standard page background.

behaviour: No GOV.UK JavaScript module is required.
Keep the warning adjacent to the action or information it qualifies.
accessibility: Retain aria-hidden on the icon and the govuk-visually-hidden Warning text.
The consequence must be understandable without seeing the icon, weight or layout.
Do not use warning styling as the only indication that an action has risk.
content: State the specific consequence in plain language.
Avoid vague phrases such as “Warning: be careful” and do not duplicate “Warning” in visible text.
Tell users what they can do to avoid the consequence when that is not obvious.

htmlExamples.name: Registration warning
htmlExamples.html: ! Warning You can be fined up to £5,000 if you do not register.
